{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOLEgSIs8AAAABZa1X7Q", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bm7fazhDCLAA", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bm7fa", "number": 25, "title": "Snapshot and convert WebXR session-request arguments before asynchronous negotiation", "body": "## Problem

At `1e1e00229af2b6e048cc593cdfa7a4abb912161e`, [XRSystem.requestSession](https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/blob/1e1e00229af2b6e048cc593cdfa7a4abb912161e/src/polyfill/api/runtime.ts#L100) dereferences null options, rejects convertible mode objects, repeatedly reads caller dictionaries and consumes feature/depth iterables without retaining converted values. Negotiation rereads options after awaiting device configuration.

Applications can therefore receive different features or depth formats after changing their options immediately after the call. With activation present, an inline request's one-shot required-feature generator can be consumed by activation analysis before negotiation, allowing an unsupported required feature to disappear.

## Expected outcome

Convert and retain request arguments before asynchronous negotiation. Activation checks, feature selection and session initialization must consistently use those values. Cover the core session dictionary and existing DOM Overlay/depth initialization paths, including shared mode conversion in `isSessionSupported()`.

## Context

Start from and target `dev`. Relevant components are `src/polyfill/api/runtime.ts`, `src/types/polyfill.ts`, `CustomWebXRPolyfill.ts`, `EmulatedXRDevice.ts`, `tests/conformance.ts` and the Chromium extension runner. Configuration arrives asynchronously through `webxr-device-init`; the public API is installed synchronously. Existing dependencies include gl-matrix, Three.js 0.186.1 and Playwright.

Use the pinned [Device CRD, 9 June 2026](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webxr-20260609/), [WebIDL revision 622910c](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/whatwg/webidl/622910c67c724e362f71e8255a0380bade261acb/index.bs), [Depth WD, 25 August 2026](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/WD-webxr-depth-sensing-1-20260825/) and [DOM Overlay WD, 24 September 2024](https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/WD-webxr-dom-overlays-1-20240924/).

Applicability: inline on both profiles; Quest `immersive-vr`, Quest `immersive-ar`, and Android `immersive-ar`. `depth-sensing` remains the existing virtual CPU path on both AR profiles. `dom-overlay` retains its opt-in original-root preview restrictions. This task adds no feature descriptor. Other unfinished modules remain within the fixed goal.

All 24 currently listed Issues/PRs are closed. [PR #24](https://github.com/takahirox/WebXR-emulator-extension/pull/24) excluded session-request conversion; #11's closure explicitly retained broader core/WebIDL gaps. This is a bounded continuation, not a reopening of the consolidated implementation scope.

WPT reconciliation: pinned `xrDevice_requestSession_no_mode.https.html` expects a synchronous throw. The pinned WebIDL operation algorithm converts exceptions from Promise-returning operations into rejected Promises. Record this discrepancy when adapting that test; preserve applicable unknown-required, optional-feature and no-gesture assertions.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Convert mode once before options access in both XRSystem methods. Accept objects converting to valid mode strings; reject missing/invalid modes and Symbol conversion with `TypeError` through rejected Promises. Getter/conversion failures retain their original rejection reason.
- [ ] Accept omitted, undefined, null, empty and function-valued session dictionaries; reject other primitive dictionaries. Undefined members mean absent. For the scoped members, read inherited/nonenumerable properties once in order: `depthSensing`, `domOverlay`, `optionalFeatures`, `requiredFeatures`. Do not enumerate callers or read unknown properties.
- [ ] Convert feature sequences and their DOMString elements once. Accept Sets and generators; reject null, primitive strings and noniterable sequence values with `TypeError`. Activation analysis and negotiation reuse the snapshot. Unknown required descriptors reject with `NotSupportedError`; unknown optional descriptors are omitted. Retain default `viewer` and immersive `local` grants.
- [ ] Snapshot nested depth initialization in order: `dataFormatPreference`, `depthTypeRequest`, `matchDepthView`, `usagePreference`. Enforce required preference sequences, enum conversion and boolean/default conversion (`matchDepthView=true`), even when the descriptor is absent. Supplied null depth dictionaries fail required-member conversion. Preserve supported CPU format selection and empty-preference defaults; the optional depth-type request may remain ignored as permitted by the pinned draft. Unsupported configurations reject required or omit optional depth.
- [ ] Preserve nullable `domOverlay`. For non-null dictionaries, convert the required Element root once, accepting genuine same-origin cross-realm Elements and rejecting invalid brands with `TypeError`. Retain the original Element reference; changing the caller's root property afterward cannot substitute another root. Continue checking live presentation eligibility and restoring preview resources on failure/end.
- [ ] Demonstrate that immediate caller mutation and delayed device initialization cannot alter converted feature lists, depth preferences or selected root. Conversion finishes before activation/concurrency checks and before awaiting configuration. Failed conversions create no session or presentation resources and do not strand the pending immersive flag.
- [ ] Preserve activation and ownership behavior: ordinary inline requests need no activation; explicit inline features other than `inline-stereo` require it. Immersive requests require activation; an allowed overlapping request rejects with `InvalidStateError`. Cover recovery after conversion/negotiation failure and session end, without disturbing an existing session. Verify enabled-feature reporting and usable frames after successful creation.
- [ ] Add focused cases to the existing browser harness for inline on both profiles and all three immersive profile/mode combinations, including deferred configuration and one-shot iterables. The Coordinator runs `npm run build` and `npm run test:browser` with these cases. Record actual browser/version, commands, outcomes, failures and skips. Existing test code and historical passes are not evidence that the new cases passed.
- [ ] Update the capability inventory and implementation PR with scope, pinned references and execution evidence. The Coordinator owns implementation, tests and normal repository PR review. Correct mistaken AI requirements using primary evidence, retaining the original assumption, correction, source and rationale in the Issue/PR without human approval or independent AI re-review. Preserve the goal and meaningful acceptance; do not weaken criteria to accommodate unfinished work or failures.

## Optional validation

Adapt additional applicable request-session WPT assertions at `e1859580b5fcf74940a18d2f783296b4961035e3`, recording fake-device harness substitutions and specification discrepancies.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
